title: SREV-067 Secure UAC packet input gate contract

type1_strings.description: Type 1 elevation ApplicationName, CommandLine, and CurrentDirectory pointers

contracts: wcslen requires a null-terminated wide-character string input
wmemcpy requires valid source and destination buffers for the requested character count
Type 1 elevation may be classified only after ProcessHandle and all three packet string pointers are non-null
Secure_HandleElevation may serialize a packet only after Dll_Alloc returns a non-null packet buffer
Malformed type 1 elevation arguments must fail closed before global elevation state is set
